text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A legend was born today! Not even those
in the senior year can match
her!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has become a Five Crown
champion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Really... She shook off all her would-be
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're getting another phone call...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Another interview request? How many is
that now?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't stopped ringing since we left the
Arima Kinen yesterday...
Yes, hello?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The amount of media coverage is
unbelievable...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me! The calls from journalists won't
stop—they want to speak
with Narita
Brian...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Brian continues to amaze me, both on the
course and with the
reaction she's
garnered...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Brian continues to amaze me, both on the
course and with the
reaction she's
garnered...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And just where is the ravenous rascal
herself at a time like this?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Triple Crown champion, victory at the
Arima Kinen, five G1 wins...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But the gnawing won't stop. I'm still aching
for more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: When... When is the next race?!
